components.name: Equity volatility
components.source: Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), daily close, via FRED

components.name: Credit stress
components.source: ICE BofA US High Yield Index option-adjusted spread, via FRED

components.name: Yield curve
components.source: 10-year minus 3-month US Treasury yield, via FRED

components.name: Financial conditions
components.source: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (weekly), via FRED

confirmation.meaning: The state moves up on the first day the rule says so. It moves down only after the rule has said a lower state for 5 trading days in a row, and then only to the highest state seen in those days.
confirmation.starting_point: The first v3 record starts from the last state published under v2. The four v2 state names keep their names in v3.
confirmation.trading_days: Dates on which a daily market input (VIX, high-yield spread, yield curve) has an observation.

changes_from_v2: Five states instead of four. A new state, Guarded, sits between Calm and Watch.
Score bands: 0-14 Calm, 15-29 Guarded, 30-49 Watch, 50-74 Elevated, 75-100 Stress. Under v2: 0-24 Calm, 25-49 Watch, 50-74 Elevated, 75-100 Stress.
Elevated and Stress, the floors, the component thresholds, the score formula and the confirmation step are unchanged.
